terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: You cannot walk between T1 International and the domestic terminals T2 and T3. The free Terminal Transfer Bus runs every 15 minutes from 05:30 to 22:30; the journey takes 10 minutes. At T1, the stop is on the arrivals level outside Arrival Hall B; at T2 and T3, it is outside each terminal on the arrivals level.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: In T1 International, an interactive children’s area with touchscreens is near gate 10, the McDonalds playground near gate 50, and a digital area created with the Museum of Applied Arts and Science near gate 53. Toilets, parents’ rooms and feeding areas are near baggage reclaim.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.hint: Sydney Airport Free WiFi in T1
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout T1 International. Select Sydney Airport Free WiFi, answer the questions, read the terms and press Proceed. An advertisement is then shown and a website opens.
